gaps.title: Same face kit on every species and it never changes
gaps.detail: About 15 species share one face kit and the face never changes with state: the same expression attacking, hurt or dying. Give species their own faces and drive expression from state.

gaps.title: Act I creatures have no models
gaps.detail: Crabbit, Hoot Couture, Batterfly, Twiglet, Quietling (the Act I footsoldier) and Mumbleroot (the Act I boss) have no body at all, plus the long stand-in list from the battle rules piece. The hours that decide whether a child loves this have no new monsters per region.
